# Cutzioo

> Cutzioo is a modern barbershop booking and management platform for barbers, stylists, and their clients — publish a booking page, manage appointments, and grow your business.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Cutzioo for barbers and clients.
- [Find a Barber](/find-barber): Discover independent barbers and stylists near you.
- [Find a Barbershop](/find-barbershop): Browse local barbershops accepting online bookings.
- [Booking Forms Directory](/bookingforms): Public directory of businesses accepting bookings on Cutzioo.
- [Sign in / Create account](/auth): Sign in or create a Cutzioo account.
